title: Pounce helps incoming students complete college enrollment
summary: Among students already committed to Georgia State, Pounce increased enrollment by 3.3 percentage points.
account: Georgia State used AdmitHub’s Pounce to help admitted students complete enrollment tasks from April through August 2016. Researchers assigned 7,489 students to the assistant or usual support. Pounce used university records to send relevant reminders, answered questions, and referred unresolved questions to counselors. Among 1,948 students who had already committed to attend, the researchers found that enrollment increased by 3.3 percentage points from a control rate of 84.6%. The overall enrollment effect was not statistically significant. The study evaluated the complete service, including staff assistance, and did not measure degree completion.
purpose: Pounce was deployed to guide admitted students through pre-enrollment tasks. Higher on-time enrollment is that purpose.
system: Pounce, AdmitHub’s SMS assistant with supervised learning and a Georgia State knowledge base
segment: College transition support for admitted students

ratings.reason: More already-committed students completed college enrollment.

ai_role.statement: Pounce interpreted questions, sent reminders, and routed questions that it could not answer to university staff. The trial measured the combined service, not machine learning alone.
